title: Action
description: An action. Class-level properties describe the action type and its parameters. Instance-level properties describe a concrete action executed at a specific time.

id.description: [instance-level] Stable identifier for this action execution.

run_id.description: [instance-level] Identifier of the run this action belongs to.

agent_id.description: [instance-level] Identifier of the agent that executed the action.

timestamp_s.description: [instance-level] Simulated time in seconds when the action was executed.

version.description: [class-level] Schema version of the action record format.

target_instance_id.description: [instance-level] Identifier of the object instance the action targets, if any.

parameters.description: [instance-level] Action-specific parameters (direction, force, duration, etc.) as key/value pairs.

intention_id.description: [instance-level] Identifier of the intention this action fulfills, if any.

examples.result_description: The coconut began to move after being touched.
